title: armeria villosa subsp. carratracensis
intro: Armeria villosa subsp. carratracensis, commonly known as the Iberian armeria, is a plant species within the primulaceae family. The Iberian armeria is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Iberian Peninsula, where it has been employed to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of the Iberian armeria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
